sloka: ततः प्रहृष्टाः कपयः ससुग्रीवविभीषणाः ।साधु साध्विति नेदुश्च दृष्ट्वा शत्रुं प्रधर्षितम् ।। ६.४४.३२ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ kapayaḥ sasugrīvavibhīṣaṇāḥ ।sādhu sādhviti neduśca dṛṣṭvā śatruṁ pradharṣitam ।। 6.44.32 ।।।।

translations.english: All beings present in war were aware of Indrajith's deeds. Therefore, they were gratified to see him defeated.
